mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_recipient(session_id,student_id) SELECT #{sessionId},e.student_id FROM course_enrollment e JOIN app_user u ON u.id=e.student_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND u.enabled=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,course_id courseId,teacher_id teacherId,mode,passcode,(closed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>NOW(3)) active FROM attendance_session WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,s.title,s.mode,s.passcode,s.created_at createdAt,s.expires_at expiresAt,(s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>NOW(3)) active,COUNT(r.student_id) expectedCount,COUNT(r.signed_at) signedCount FROM attendance_session s LEFT JOIN attendance_recipient r ON r.session_id=s.id WHERE s.course_id=#{courseId} GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(c.id AS CHAR) courseId,c.name courseName,s.title,s.mode,s.created_at createdAt,s.expires_at expiresAt,(s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>NOW(3)) active,r.signed_at signedAt FROM attendance_session s JOIN attendance_recipient r ON r.session_id=s.id AND r.student_id=#{studentId} JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY (s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>NOW(3) AND r.signed_at IS NULL) DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) id,u.username,u.real_name realName,r.signed_at signedAt FROM attendance_recipient r JOIN app_user u ON u.id=r.student_id WHERE r.session_id=#{id} ORDER BY u.username
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_recipient WHERE session_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_recipient SET signed_at=COALESCE(signed_at,NOW(3)) WHERE session_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
UPDATE attendance_session SET closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at,NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{id}
